title: Extended-state DMT trials yield encounters with sentient others
place_text: Imperial College London; University of California San Diego

tellings.quote: minutes. And And those volunteers are all coming back with reports of encounters with sentient others.

plain: In trials at Imperial College London and the University of California San Diego, volunteers are kept under DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, for longer stretches than usual, and they keep coming back with reports of meeting "sentient others". The writer Graham Hancock, who writes about lost ancient civilisations, tells Michels this, drawing on researchers such as Andrew Gallimore and Rick Strassman but naming no particular study. If the reports mean what he thinks, the drug would be opening contact with beings that exist apart from the mind.
